subject: Law
question: Consider the following statements in view of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 : Statement I : Theft in dwelling house, etc., is a Non-compoundable offence. Statement II : The offence extortion is cognizable.

subject: Law
question: In which case, the Supreme Court held that, right to life includes the right to livelihood also ? a. Olga Tellis b. Maneka Gandhi c. Bennett and Coleman d. A.H. Wadia
explanation: ओल्गा टेलिस विरुद्ध बॉम्बे म्युनिसिपल कॉर्पोरेशन या खटल्यात सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाने म्हटले की जगण्याच्या हक्कात उपजीविकेचा हक्क समाविष्ट आहे.

subject: Law
question: Provision for "Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases" are made in which of the following articles of the Indian Constitution ?
explanation: भारतीय राज्यघटनेच्या कलम २२ मध्ये विशिष्ट प्रकरणांत अटक आणि अटक करण्यापासून संरक्षणाची तरतूद आहे.

subject: Law
question: In which of the following cases has it been held that the writ of Habeas Corpus can be issued not only for releasing a person from illegal detention but also for protecting prisoners from inhuman and barbarous treatment ?

options.C: Sachin Batra vs. Delhi Public Administration

explanation: सुनील बत्रा विरुद्ध दिल्ली प्रशासन या खटल्यात हे स्पष्ट केले गेले.

subject: Law
question: In which of the following years was the Article 51A (K) inserted in Indian Constitution ?
explanation: कलम ५१A (K) ८६ व्या घटनादुरुस्ती कायदा, २००२ द्वारे समाविष्ट करण्यात आले.

subject: Law
question: Special provision with respect to the State of Nagaland has been made under which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution ?
explanation: नागालँड राज्यासाठी विशेष तरतूद कलम ३७१A अंतर्गत केली आहे.

subject: Law
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides the provisions for qualifications for the membership of the State Legislature ?
explanation: भारतीय राज्यघटनेच्या कलम १७३ मध्ये राज्य विधान मंडळाच्या सदस्यत्वाच्या पात्रतेच्या तरतुदी दिल्या आहेत.

subject: Law
question: Consider the following statements about the Governor : a. He submits his resignation letter to the Chief Justice of the State. b. He should have completed 35 years of age. c. His emoluments, allowances and privileges are determined by the President. d. No criminal proceedings can be instituted against him. Spot the incorrect statements.
explanation: राज्यपाल आपला राजीनामा राष्ट्रपतींकडे देतात, मुख्य न्यायाधीशांकडे नाही. त्यामुळे (a) अयोग्य. राज्यपालांविरुद्ध फौजदारी कारवाई सुरू करता येत नाही, त्यामुळे (d) योग्य. (b) आणि (d) हे अयोग्य विधाने आहेत.

subject: Law
question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added a new clause (K) as Eleventh Fundamental Duty to the Constitution ?
explanation: ८६ व्या घटनादुरुस्ती कायदा, २००२ ने कलम ५१A (K) जोडले.
